briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: Elite: Collect the Magistrate Verdict Court: Ascension Seal. Enter Magistrate Verdict Court on Black-Iron Debt Descent through The Black-Iron Gate while the Gate remains Distortion Gate bound by contract clauses. Reference deity voice is Lilith, but the player still chooses one deity from the faction roster. Objective: With one selected deity, defeat the boss encounter against The Volcanic Glass Magistrate inside the elite-tuned Magistrate Verdict Court and complete the Ascension route without breaking canon.

missionIntro.speaker: Lilith Divine Voice
missionIntro.text: Every step is a clause, and every clause has teeth. The Magistrate Verdict Court will know whether one deity is enough.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lore Director
enemyIntroduction.text: Enemies are not filler here; they are the boss pressure of Black-Iron Debt Descent made hostile.

midBattle.speaker: Gameplay Director
midBattle.text: Read the room law first: Exploit or avoid the route rule: hellfire clauses that burn unpaid debts

victory.speaker: Lilith Divine Voice
victory.text: The debt is not erased. It is owned.

defeat.speaker: Lilith Divine Voice
defeat.text: Withdraw. The The Black-Iron Gate has learned too much from this attempt.

codex.speaker: Lore Director
codex.text: The Infernal Dominion is the source Realm; mortal myth is only the later echo. This beat documents Magistrate Verdict Court as part of Black-Iron Debt Descent.

soloTitanPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield deity; roster/Deity language is excluded from standard mission combat.
visualDirection: Frame Magistrate Verdict Court as a boss node in Black-Iron Debt Descent; black iron crowns, volcanic glass armor, contract parchment skin, chain mantles, ember fissures, horn hierarchies, bat/dragon wing shadows, clawed court gloves, blood wax seals, ash velvet, obsidian thrones, coin/debt motifs, execution architecture.

mythosGatesDialogueRecreation.speakerRule: Use faction divine voice, Lore Director, or Gameplay Director; no playable Titan language.
mythosGatesDialogueRecreation.soloRule: Dialogue supports one active god or goddess in the field.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield deity; roster/Titan language is excluded from player-facing copy except legacy IDs.
